name: FDM 3D printing
cost_model_seed: material volume plus print time plus setup
risk_notes: Dimensional tolerance depends on machine and operator

name: CNC milling
cost_model_seed: stock plus machine time plus setup plus finishing
risk_notes: Deep pockets and tight tolerances increase cost

name: Sheet metal fabrication
cost_model_seed: blank size plus cutting plus bends plus finishing
risk_notes: Bend radius and relief features must match shop capabilities

name: Waterjet or laser profile cutting
cost_model_seed: cut length plus pierces plus material plus setup

name: PCB fabrication and assembly
cost_model_seed: board area plus layer count plus assembly line items
risk_notes: Board house design rules control manufacturability
Component availability can dominate lead time

name: Wire harness fabrication
cost_model_seed: connector count plus wire length plus terminations plus test requirements
risk_notes: Bend radius, strain relief, and service loops need mechanical review

name: Off-the-shelf part sourcing
cost_model_seed: supplier price breaks plus shipping plus lead time risk
risk_notes: Datasheet and supplier terms are separate from catalog metadata
